name: HEAVY_VEHICLES_EXCEPTED_MMS_WHITE_SQUARE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the white edge and edge + black border (6 / 18 = edge 6 + border 12), as the AS 1743 drawings. RM9-SA109A 600 x 600 multi-message-frame module (1:10 sheet, 2020; titled 'guide sign' but an RM9 auxiliary): black border 25, no white edge, square corners. HEAVY 90 D, VEHICLES 90 C, EXCEPTED 90 C; chain 185/160/160/95: tops 95, 255, 415. Widths HEAVY 380 (110/380/110), VEHICLES 465 (65/465/70), EXCEPTED 480 (60/480/60). Multi-message frames only.
